summary: Iteration 4 (IQ Simulator, Player DNA, Archetype Lab) fully tested. Backend: 20/20 pytest green (test_iter4.py). IQ: /iq/scenarios returns categories+difficulties+total; /iq/next returns scenario WITHOUT any answer/explanation fields (verified banned keys correct/best_decision/why/defense_giving/should_notice/alternatives/game_application absent from payload) and options carry only key+text; category filter honored. /iq/answer grades with all required fields (correct, acceptable, correct_key, best_decision, why, defense_giving, should_notice, alternatives[], game_application), 404 on unknown scenario, persists attempt. /iq/profile per-category score null <3 attempts; overall null <5 then non-null after 5+, avg_decision_sec computed, categories list of 9 IQ_CATEGORIES minus overall. /iq/insights returns enough_data=false with 6-scenario message for fresh user, enough_data=true JSON {summary,recommended_skill,recommended_drill,recommended_player,training_priority} after 6+ attempts (AI ~5-10s). DNA: /api/dna returns 14 categories (score int or null), current_label, dev_index, timeline (upserts monthly dna_snapshot), changes[], enough_data, story either AI-generated or exact 'Not enough data yet…' sentinel. Fresh user has >=8 null categories (no fabrication). Archetype: /archetype/current returns primary/secondary/target, confidence(int|null), estimate flag, supporting/gaps/all_archetypes. POST /archetype/target returns fit%, estimate, strengths, gaps, missing_skills[{slug,name}], recommended_drills, iq_focus[{key,label}], players (ALL ids verified as real /api/players ids — e.g. stephen-curry, kevin-durant, kobe-bryant, hakeem-olajuwon, chris-paul), development_path[]; persists profile.target_archetype (verified via /auth/me). /archetype/build and /experiment return the full AI JSON shape. Regression: /coach/chat still returns {reply} (recent context now injects IQ + target archetype, no error), /dashboard has trained_today+development_score, /shots aggregate ok, /goals ok. Isolation: fresh signed-up user has iq_profile empty (total_answered=0, overall=null, all category scores null), DNA shows Not-enough-data path. Frontend (Playwright via public URL): /iq loads, Practice mode -> Start loads iq-scenario -> click iq-option-A colors correct/wrong and shows iq-result panel; profile side shows 9 iq-cat-* bars; iq-next loads new scenario; Game-like (timed) mode shows countdown seconds in iq-scenario; iq-insights-btn present. /dna renders dna-current-label='PULL-UP SNIPER', 14 dna-cat-* bars (null ones show 'Not enough data yet'), dna-story (117 chars real AI), dna-timeline present. /archetype loads, archetype-analyze produces archetype-gap panel with 4 gap-skill-* links, 2 gap-iq-* links (deep-link into /iq?category= — verified category select correctly pre-selects pick_and_roll), 6 gap-player-* links to real player pages; build-input/build-btn -> build-result rendered; exp-input/exp-btn -> exp-result rendered. No console errors. No new bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1372 build_ai prompt contains the literal string '{k:v for available}' inside the f-string (double-braces escaped) — it's harmless content sent to the LLM but reads like an unfinished Python comprehension. Consider replacing with a plain phrase like 'measured DNA scores are'.

compute_dna re-runs on every /dna, /archetype/current, /archetype/target, /archetype/build, /archetype/experiment call — each iterates iq_attempts (up to 5000), analyses (200) and shot_stats. For heavy users this fans out to 4-5 duplicate Mongo scans per page load; consider memoizing per-request or caching for a short TTL.

iq_next uses random.choice on scenarios filtered by min attempts; when the user has answered every scenario at least once, the 'least seen' set becomes all scenarios and duplicates will repeat. Not a bug but consider a 'no-repeat within N answers' guard.
dna_snapshot upsert stores full scores dict including keys with None values — timeline diffing works because we filter available, but the snapshot doc grows regardless. Fine for now.

archetype/target 'gap_keys' extension iterates bp.emphasis then bp.players, but the inner loop key 'k' is later used as a Mongo/PLAYERS id when it's actually a DNA-category key on the first pass; the `if k in GAP_PLAYERS else [k]` fallback masks this — if GAP_PLAYERS ever misses a key, a raw category slug like 'basketball_iq' will end up trying to match a PLAYERS id. Consider making that explicit.
test_credentials: smoke@test.com / test1234 (has profile primary_archetype 'Pull-Up Sniper', IQ attempts, sessions).
seed_data_creation: Created 2-3 TEST_ signup+onboarded users and inserted ~6-7 iq_attempts on one of them to exercise profile/insights gates. Set smoke user profile.target_archetype via /archetype/target during test (persists) — should not affect other tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IQ scenarios are a static bank in /app/backend/iq_data.py; grading is deterministic (correct-key match + alternatives list -> acceptable). /api/players returns {players:[...]} (dict wrapper), not a bare list. AI endpoints (iq/insights, dna/story, archetype/build, archetype/experiment, coach/chat) can take 5-25s; use >=40s timeouts. Fresh test users routed to /onboarding until POST /onboarding is called. Archetype fit uses default 45 for missing DNA scores and sets estimate=true — that is by design, do not treat as fabrication.
